title: H. A Certain Scientific Tree Problem

legend: Misaka has come up with a very good problem for this contest. Unfortunately, that problem already exists (on at least 3 different online judges!) so she has to add a creative twist to it!

Consider a full binary tree of depth d$$$d$$$. Remember a full binary tree with depth d$$$d$$$ has 2d−1$$$2^d - 1$$$ nodes and there is an edge from each node u$$$u$$$ (2≤u≤2d−1)$$$(2 \leq u \leq 2^d -1)$$$ to its parent ⌊u2⌋$$$\left \lfloor \frac{u}{2} \right \rfloor$$$. Misaka asks you to find the sum of distances between every pair of nodes on the tree.
Formally if n=2d−1$$$n = 2^d - 1$$$ (n=#$$$n = \#$$$ nodes on the tree), compute:
where dist(i,j)$$$dist(i, j)$$$ is the minimum number of edges on any path between node i$$$i$$$ to node j$$$j$$$.
input: The first line will contain one integer T$$$T$$$ denoting the number of multitests (1≤T≤5)$$$(1 \leq T \leq 5)$$$.
The first line of each test will contain one integer d$$$d$$$ the depth of the binary tree (1≤d≤105)$$$(1 \leq d \leq 10^5)$$$.
Testcases in subtasks are numbered 1−20$$$1 - 20$$$ with samples skipped.

Testcases 1−4$$$1 - 4$$$ satisfy i$$$i$$$'th multitest of the j$$$j$$$'th testcase has d=(j−1)⋅5+i$$$d = (j-1)\cdot5 + i$$$. For instance testcase 2$$$2$$$ will consist of d=[6,7,8,9,10]$$$d = [6, 7, 8, 9, 10]$$$ across the 5$$$5$$$ multitests.
The remaining testcases do not satisfy any additional constraints.
output: Output one integer S$$$S$$$ per testcase denoting the sum of distances across all pairs of nodes on the tree. Since this number may be very large, please find it modulo 109+7$$$10^9 + 7$$$.
note: In the first sample, the tree only has 1$$$1$$$ node. As dist(1,1)=0$$$dist(1, 1) = 0$$$, the answer would just be 0$$$0$$$.
In the second sample, there are 3$$$3$$$ nodes on a full binary tree with depth 2$$$2$$$. There are edges 1−2$$$1 - 2$$$ and 1−3$$$1 - 3$$$.

legend.ai: Misaka 为本次比赛想出了一个非常好的问题。遗憾的是，这个问题已经存在（至少在 3 个不同的在线评测平台上！），所以她不得不为它加入一个富有创意的变化！

考虑一棵深度为 d$$$d$$$ 的满二叉树。记住，一棵深度为 d$$$d$$$ 的满二叉树有 2d−1$$$2^d - 1$$$ 个节点，并且对于每个节点 u$$$u$$$(2≤u≤2d−1$$$(2 \leq u \leq 2^d -1)$$$)，都有一条边连接它与其父节点 ⌊u2⌋$$$\left \lfloor \frac{u}{2} \right \rfloor$$$。Misaka 要求你求出树上每一对节点之间的距离之和。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 T$$$T$$$，表示多组测试数据的组数 (1≤T≤5)$$$(1 \leq T \leq 5)$$$。
